policy: External sources inform independently expressed Mission Control mechanisms. No source code or distinctive prose from these sources is incorporated by this hardening unless a future change records the exact reused material and satisfies its license obligations.

contribution: specification-driven development as an explicit stage before implementation
separation of specification, planning, task decomposition, implementation and convergence
defect workflow that begins from observed/reproduced behavior rather than immediate mutation
sources.mission_control_derivation: Mission Control independently defines executable specification contracts, bidirectional traceability, amendment invalidation and convergence gates suitable for multi-cell engineering missions.

contribution: incremental concrete-syntax parsing as a structural code-intelligence mechanism
changed-range/stable-tree analysis as a preferable basis for structure-aware mutation
multi-language parser infrastructure as one admissible structural engine
sources.mission_control_derivation: Mission Control does not mandate Tree-sitter itself. It requires structural-first mutation when syntax/semantic structure matters and permits Tree-sitter, compiler ASTs, language servers, schema-aware rewriters, queryable IRs or generator owners according to the target.

contribution: semantic validation of GitHub Actions workflow syntax, expressions, and context availability
independent workflow-definition validation before candidate jobs are trusted as executable evidence
sources.mission_control_derivation: Mission Control requires CI definitions to be validated from a separate stable gate because a malformed candidate workflow can fail before it creates jobs. The repository executes a pinned actionlint release with a verified archive checksum; actionlint is evidence tooling, not Mission Control runtime authority.
